question:
**Direction: The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.**

She wraped the gift in a gift paper.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Wrapped."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given spelling of the word **"wraped"** is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"wrapped"** with double** "p".**
 
• **"Wrapped"** means to put paper or cloth around somebody/something as a cover. (किसी वस्‍तु पर काग़ज़ चढ़ाना या किसी व्‍यकि्त पर कपड़ा लपेटना)
 
 
• **Example**:* She **wrapped**__ the gift.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
